title: T21 Research Assistant: An AI-Powered Trisomy 21 Research Assistant
description: Section-aware, multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system for evidence-based question answering over the open-access Down syndrome (Trisomy 21) literature. Includes the data ingestion pipeline, the eight-stage LangGraph RAG pipeline, the Streamlit web interface, and the evaluation notebooks. This archive is the code version described in the Scientific Reports manuscript 'An AI-Powered Trisomy 21 Research Assistant'.
